title: 有数 MCP Key 配置指引
description: 更全面的功能请前往有数开放平台：https://open.yscredit.com/mcp/guide，在页面中点击"一键免费接入"，复制生成的提示词，返回 WorkBuddy，将提示词粘贴发送给模型，即可自动完成配置。如仅需使用对公营销助手基础功能，也可前往平台点击右上角头像"获取 MCP Key"，将 Key 粘贴到下方输入框。Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: For full capabilities, visit the YouShu Open Platform at https://open.yscredit.com/mcp/guide, click "One-click Free Access", copy the generated prompt, return to WorkBuddy, paste and send it to the model to auto-configure. To use only the basic corporate marketing assistant features, you can also visit the platform, click your profile avatar in the top-right corner, select "Get MCP Key", and paste it into the field below. The Key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 前往有数开放平台配置
docLabel_en: Go to YouShu Open Platform to configure

fields.description: 用于访问有数 MCP 服务的鉴权凭证。支持两种配置方式：① 将提示词发送给模型自动完成；② 前往有数开放平台点击右上角头像"获取 MCP Key"手动粘贴。仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
fields.description_en: Authentication credential for YouShu MCP service. Two configuration options: 1) send the prompt to the model for auto-configuration; 2) visit the YouShu Open Platform, click your profile avatar to "Get MCP Key" and paste manually. Stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only.
